messages:
Marie (Marketing): Heads-up — EU region experiencing intermittent latency for hosted API since ~08:12 UTC. Ops says mitigation underway. Need: status page copy, customer email timing, and guidance for Dedicated/Private customers. Can we align quickly? :eyes:

Alex P (Ops): On it. We're toggling a routing fallback and draining a bad host. Targeting mitigation by 08:40 UTC. No data loss. I'll confirm when the degraded pod set is drained.

Sam S (Product): From product POV, highlight slower model responses and possible streaming interruptions. Recommend setting status page to 'investigating' now, then update to 'degraded performance' with an ETA once Alex confirms.

Jia R (Comms): Drafting copy below — please react with 👍/✋. I think we should hold email for ~30 min unless ETA slips.

Jia R (Comms): ```
Investigating: Intermittent latency in EU region affecting API requests and streaming responses. We're actively routing around impacted hosts and expect recovery by ~08:40 UTC. No data loss. We'll post further updates here and notify affected customers if the issue extends beyond 30 minutes.
```

Alex P (Ops): Looks good. Change "expect recovery by ~08:40 UTC" to "targeting recovery by 08:40 UTC" (so we're not too definitive).

Marie (Marketing): Agreed. Also include a link to the Dedicated console incident page for impacted customers: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/1765-eu-latency

OpsBot: Incident created: INC-1765 · Priority P2 · Assigned to Alex P · Started 1765004321 · https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-1765

Sam S (Product): For the customer email — keep it short, include link to status page and a CTA to contact support for SLA-critical issues. Jia, can you prepare an email snippet? Ping me for quick approvals.

Jia R (Comms): Draft email snippet below. If no objections I will publish the status page now and queue the email for 30 minutes.

Jia R (Comms): ```
Subject: EU API latency — investigating

Hi —
We're experiencing intermittent latency in the EU region affecting API performance and streaming connections. Our engineers are actively working on a fix; we are targeting recovery by 08:40 UTC. No customer data has been affected. We'll send an update in 30 minutes or sooner if the situation changes.

If this impacts your SLA-critical workflows, please reply to this message or contact support@redwood.ai for prioritized assistance.

Thanks,
Redwood Status Team
```

Alex P (Ops): Confirmed fallback applied — observed ~40% reduction in error spikes so far. I'll update again at 08:30 with a tighter ETA.

Marie (Marketing): :thumbsup: Publishing status page now with Jia's edited copy (using "targeting" language). Jia, please queue the email to go out at 08:42 if we don't need to escalate.

Sam S (Product): Thanks everyone. Keeping an eye on the incident channel.

Jia R (Comms): Will do — queuing email and will post another update here in 15m unless Alex updates earlier.

OpsBot: Note: next automated update scheduled in 900s."
